notes.title: Dark Invasion VR - The Bunker closed beta is near!
notes.notes:
The next content update is near. We builded a complete zombie infected bunker for you. After that we gonna invade the city with zombie hordes and than we gonna proceed through an police station.
The closed beta is almost ready to take on the ride for curators, influencers and streamers!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36211720/c8ac7410cc184cdec88b102c8d9b306a2cfdd0e8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: A new teammember of Dark Invasion VR introduces himself
notes.notes:
Good day VR friends and horror game lovers.

I just joined the team of Vadim Silver and we startet the last months together to create awesome new content with excellent horror ambient and storyline. The new maps are ripped out of our hardest nightmares we ever had,  we managed to loom our nightmares together and now you are close to enter them. But we need some more time to polish everything up to the best possible ways. The next update is near and it brings in a complete reborn version of the game.

Sincerly,
Bastian Petersen

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36211720/60c7a79fa31392174ac676e1ec98e88367727ccd.png[/img]

notes.title: Dark Invasion VR - Fresh update!
notes.notes:
What's new?

Infected zombies now have tentacles, claws and etc.

Updated the effect of teleporting zombies and aliens.

The order of passing the levels has appeared.

notes.title: Added a new location - Oil Rig
notes.notes:
New location - Oil Rig. Endless Сlips and Zombies, the key to a good result in the Leaderboard!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36211720/b200b37b66a077a1ec086ce30057456b9a4a4b24.jpg[/img]

You have to find a canister and fill it with fuel. Next, in a teeming zombie and monster location, you need to find a pickup and fill up it with fuel to leave this creepy place by collecting as many score as possible!
